subject: Re: Expansion request — staging rollout for new LOBs and API keys

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request: staging rollout for additional LOBs

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. We signed the baseline renewal, and the execs are asking to expand Redwood to two additional Lines of Business (Home & Marketplace teams). They want a staged approach: dev -> staging -> prod for each LOB, separate API keys per app, and per-key throughput caps during the first 90 days.

Can you share a suggested rollout matrix (timing, per-key quotas, signed addendum for increased committed throughput) and an estimate of cost delta for adding ~6 apps across the two LOBs? Also, procurement will need the updated SOW/addendum for signatures.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Platform Integrations
Crestline Retail
Phone: +1-415-555-0192

----

Note: CCing procurement in follow-ups.
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request: staging rollout for additional LOBs

Hi Amit — really excited to help Crestline scale this out. Summary / next steps below.

High-level proposal (preview):
- Phased onboarding per LOB (Home first, Marketplace second).
- Per-app API keys (6 new keys total) with initial soft quotas and a 90‑day ramp plan.
- Temporary staging quotas (non-billable) for validation, then production quotas tied to committed throughput in addendum.
- Single consolidated addendum to attach to your renewal that lists extra committed tokens and per-key guardrails.

Action items I need from you to finalize a quote and addendum:
1) A short prioritization of the 6 apps (names + primary owner).
2) Any strict cutover dates for Marketplace (if they must be in prod by a specific date).
3) Security checklist items your InfoSec wants included in the addendum (if any deviations from our standard).

I'm attaching a draft staged-rollout matrix and a capacity-commitment quote for rough numbers. Laura / Rishi — can you review the attached numbers and confirm per-key soft quotas for staging and recommended production commit tiers?

I'll prepare a first-pass addendum (word doc) once we lock the app list.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 12:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request: staging rollout for additional LOBs

Karthik — quick internal note with numbers.

Assumptions: 6 apps across two LOBs, initial prod baseline similar traffic to their current Checkout service (~120M tokens/month aggregate per new LOB after ramp). We recommend the following:
- Staging (per-key soft quota): 10k tokens/day (unmetered during validation window, but enforced to avoid runaway).
- Prod (initial commit per key): 6 apps => offer three tiers: 2 keys at 30M tokens/mo, 2 keys at 10M tokens/mo, 2 keys at 5M tokens/mo.
- Buffer / burst: Allow 25% burst within SLA but bill against committed pool.

Commercial ask: for the committed throughput above, propose a blended uplift of ~27% on top of their existing renewal per-month commitment. Exact numbers in the attached PDF.

Marissa — will need help preparing a short addendum (template below) and confirm any discounts for multi-key commits.

- Laura

Attachments: capacity-commitment-quote.pdf
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@crestline-retail.com>, Procurement <procurement@crestline-retail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — draft addendum and rollout plan

Amit / Procurement — attaching a draft addendum and the staged rollout matrix for your review. Key points in the addendum:

- Scope: +6 apps across Home & Marketplace, per-app API keys (listed by placeholder name in the doc).
- Commit: incremental committed tokens: 120M tokens/month (aggregate across new apps) with a 90-day ramp schedule.
- Billing: consolidated invoice; new committed volume will be added as an appendix to the existing renewal.
- Quotas: staging quotas (10k/day per key) enforced but not billed; production quotas enforced after sign-off; burst allowed up to 25% subject to fallback rules.
- Rollout timeline: Dev (week 1), Staging validation (weeks 2–4), Prod phased (weeks 5–8). We will provide 2 weeks of dedicated onboarding support per LOB.

Please review the attached crestline-addendum-draft.docx and staged-rollout-matrix.xlsx. Highlights and a couple of questions in-line below:
1) We used placeholder app names (Home-Alpha, Home-Beta, Market-1, Market-2, Market-3, Market-4). Please send final app names + owners by EOD Friday, May 1 so we can finalize the doc.
2) Procurement: do you have an internal PO flow or preferred DocuSign recipient list?
3) InfoSec: any additional compliance checks (beyond SOC2 and encryption at rest) you need explicit language for?

If we get names/PO info by May 1 we can target a May 15 production start for the Home LOB (Marketplace to follow by June 1).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks for the draft. Procurement reviewed the addendum and the staged matrix. We can confirm:
- We’ll provide final app names and owners by EOD Thursday, May 6.
- DocuSign: please send to contracts@crestline-retail.com (this inbox forwards to legal + procurement).
- InfoSec: they requested an explicit clause for data residency for Marketplace test traffic (EU-origin traffic must be pinned to EU region), and a short note about audit log retention (minimum 12 months).

We reviewed attachments and have no redlines at this time — Procurement will wait for the update with final app names and the DocuSign link.
